description:
A Nikke from Missilis's Incubator Squad.
With no outstanding abilities, she was part of a mass-produced Nikke squad but was later expelled to the Incubator Squad as a disciplinary action.
She does not trust those around her and keeps all kinds of survival items in her bag.

lines.text: What are you looking at? Haven't you ever seen anyone eat before?
Stay out of my hair, and I'll do the same for you.
What am I supposed to do here?

Huh? You're giving me something to eat?
... You're a better person than I expected.
If it's you we're talking about... I suppose I can share a piece of bread.
I lack in a lot of areas, but I'll do the best I can.
I know I don't have much to offer, but leaving me like this is still a bit uncalled for...

I can have breaks now? What a life.
I can't remember the last time I was this at ease.
What is it? Is there something you want me to do?

Everyone here looks so happy.
... Unlike me.
I see a lot of different shops, but it seems like I don't really belong anywhere.

I'm Mori, a member of the Incubator Squad.
... Call me if you need me to do anything.

Don't waste your time and money on me.
I won't be of any help to you anyway.
Why do you insist on having expectations of me? It's a real burden on me.
... I'll try my best to do what I can, so just hold on a minute.

Why are you giving me this...?
I don't have anything to give you...

Um... er...
Thank you...
Wow... I've never received anything like this before.
How nice would it be if the world were made up entirely of people like you, Evaluator?
Thanks to you, I smiled for the first time in a long while.
If I'd met you earlier, do you think my life would have turned out differently?
Even if you bring me along, I won't be of any help.
What's up?
Moving out.
Gah! Rapture!
Screw it, whatever happens, happens!
Can I do this...?
... All right! Let's do this!
Re-reloading!
*Huff...! Huff...!*
Wait! I said wait!
I'm ready!
I-I'll eat quickly, so stop staring!
Ughh... Let's go!!
I took it down!
Did you see that?!
It worked!
Nngh!
Agh!
Ugh!
I told you... I'm no help at all...
That... actually worked? Am I not entirely worthless in battle?
